notes.title: Huge Update!! (The game package size has increased significantly)
notes.content:
Sorry, the English translation in the game is not complete yet. I will add the English translation by December 1, 2024!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!  (qwq)



====================================================================




We've updated almost two months' worth of content!!!

----------------------------------------------------------------------------

Here’s a summary of the updates:

A new level selection system has been added, along with new, super-large scenes. We’ll also optimize other scene art in the game to match this quality.
Relic optimization has been made—it's no longer just basic stat changes, but now there are many functional relics.
A bunch of new spells have been added.
Black screen loading times have been optimized (now it loads instantly).
The way resources are obtained has been changed:
Normal Battles: Gain Magic Crystals, Mana, Spells/Accessories.
Elite Battles: Gain Magic Crystals, Mana, Spells/Accessories, Relics.
Goddess Statue: Choose Health Regen or Spell Upgrade.
Shop: Spend Magic Crystals to buy Spells/Accessories, Relics, and use the Magic Workbench.
Events: Trigger story events to get Relics.
Challenges: Gain Relics.
Unknown: May trigger any of the above events.
Capital: The main resting area, includes Goddess Statue, Shop, and story content.
Boss: The ultimate challenge.
For more details, you can check the Introduction section in the game (next to the health bar), where you’ll find the game tutorial!!

---------------------------------------------------------------------

However, there are still some small things left to finish, like the relic icons (most of them are still just “?” for now, and will be updated later), and some sound effects are missing. Lastly, we hope everyone can help test for bugs, since there might be quite a few. In 7 days, I’ll finish the remaining content, and most of the scene art will be re-done. Any bugs you report will also be fixed.
